question: Which exact native entries regenerate and publish the dynamic launcher calendar on resource reload?
prototype_hypothesis: ARM AAPCS call sites and exact AP instruction recovery. Native generation/notify return values are not resource-adoption success codes.
callsite_evidence: calendar_icon_generate: AP instruction/evidence window 0xc5487a4, length 416, SHA256 ebe80139cf83f1dde2484100136c50aecb1c9b3ebd0dd86d92a22d0c6b789c77. Window is NOT an allowlist range.
calendar_icon_publish: AP instruction/evidence window 0xc5486d0, length 212, SHA256 108a6fa0e164acf149975b5be5fa81b0186f7bdab088b50442ff14502b33a8bd. Window is NOT an allowlist range.
control_flow_evidence: Generator composes launcher_icon.bin with localized weekday/current day in 112x112 widget, takes native snapshot, writes /data/app/perpetual_calendar/calendar_icon.bin and releases it.
Publication traverses launcher runtime app list, finds ID69, checks hidden/object-validity state and uses real image setter with generated pathname.
Generator ignores snapshot writer return; native fallback/file failure semantics remain unchanged, not reported as verified adoption.
ownership_analysis: Serialized UI timer, outside IRQ lock and rendering. Module retires only exact file background keys. Native snapshot/file and launcher object lifetimes remain with firmware. No forced global drop, GPU wait/reset or page rebuild added by module.
unsafe_assumptions: User-reported visible calendar reload passed; GPU and failure/recovery acceptance remain NOT_PROBED.
Native allocation, file-write and actual output pixels are not guaranteed by call completion.
Default font registry retarget does not replace existing font wrappers.
Uninitialized/mismatched app owners skip generation. No persistent native app pointer is retained.
Exact restricted symbol records only; no expanded address range or verifier bypass.
recommended_probe: Run source-compiled adapter tests, exact-AP native calendar probes, strict ELF verification, then recoverable hardware testing with repeated reloads and allocation/storage pressure.

user_device_validation.scope: Visible native calendar regeneration on resource reload using the delivered signed installer
user_device_validation.limitations: No device logs, screenshots, iteration counts or failure/GPU/restart probes supplied. Does not promote restricted symbol approval.
